title: fix(pm): label-write refuses a pm state on a pull request and pm:awaiting-merge on an issue
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xBkSS5VSbEpXah1YXtt5un2)_

Fixes #31148

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`scripts/pm/**` is repo tooling and moves no released package, so this PR takes the `skip-changeset` label and adds no `.changeset/*.md`. If `dispatch-gates` mandates a higher model tier for this surface, that mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03); this card ran on the project's default model. The dispatching seat runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` 在第 ② 步、任何写入之前拒绝两种写法：给 PR 加六个 pm 状态标签之一（含 `needs-user-decision`），给 issue 加 `pm:awaiting-merge`；`--release` 作用在 PR 上同样拒绝（它会加 `pm:queue`）。
- 为什么改：规则早已写明（SKILL.md「issue 上的信号」、`needs-user-decision`「⛔ 永不挂 PR」、「`pm:awaiting-merge` 只挂 PR」），但唯一的写标签入口不看目标是不是 PR；11-06 cloud PR #3680 因此被挂上 `needs-user-decision`，从「待你审合」清单掉进了决策箱（#31148）。
- 风险与回滚：只改这一个工具文件；摘标签永不拒绝，PR 上的 `pm:awaiting-merge` 与 issue 上的六态照常放行；目标类型读不出时拒绝而不猜；不新增 GitHub 调用、门禁、工作流或标签；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`refuseKindLabels` / `readTargetKind` 两个函数，以及它们在 `runLabelWrite` 第 ② 步与 `runRelease` 第 ② 步的两处调用。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test`，预期退出 0，`165 cases pass across 13 batteries`。
- 需要你做的：无需你操作：`check-governed-merges.mjs` 判为 NOT governed（0/1 路径命中受管面，160 行 ≤ 3000），走普通队列落地，席位契约复审 ACCEPT 后由席位落地。

## What changes

All in `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (+159 / −1):

- **`readTargetKind(card)`** reads step ①'s existing card object (no new GitHub call). The kind is `pull request` or `issue` only when the `pull_request` member (present and an object on a PR, absent on an issue) and `html_url` (`/pull/N` vs `/issues/N`) agree; anything else is no kind, with the reason.
- **`refuseKindLabels({ kind, why, add, ref })`** asks the rule of what the write ADDS, never of what it removes. Labels come from the imported vocabulary: `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`, `GOVERNED_PR_AWAITING_MERGE_LABEL` and `DECISION_INBOX_LABEL` from `check-half-states.mjs` (imported, not restated; `check-half-states.mjs` is unchanged).
- **Both label-adding paths are covered**, each right beside its `refuseTwoStates` call: `runLabelWrite` step ② (before the transport, so neither a direct write nor a relay dispatch happens) and `runRelease` step ② (a release adds `pm:queue`; the rule is asked of that label itself, as `runLabelWrite` asks of `--add`, so a release on a PR is refused before its comment even when the PR already carries `pm:queue`). No flag lets it through: `--allow-two-states` and `--dry-run` are refused the same way. Exit 2, zero writes, one sentence naming the label, the target kind and the rule.
- The quoted phrases are constants (`KIND_RULE_*`), and the self-test pins each one as a verbatim substring of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (L102 「issue 上的信号」, L107 「只挂决策卡(issue)、⛔ 永不挂 PR」, L194 「`pm:awaiting-merge` 只挂 PR、不入六态」), so a reworded rule reds the self-test instead of drifting.
- The file header gains a section "The kind rule"; the offline `fakeBoard` now answers `number`, `html_url` and (for `kind: 'pull'`) `pull_request` the way GitHub's issues endpoint does, with `kind: 'unreadable'` for the no-kind branch.

## Before / after

**A state label onto a pull request** (cloud PR #3680's shape), `--add needs-user-decision` on a PR, offline board:

- Before (`main` d3f36861): exit 0, 1 write — `④ MATCHES the target — labels \`needs-user-decision\``.
- After: exit 2, 0 writes:

```text
② REFUSED — `needs-user-decision` is a pm card STATE and objectstack-ai/cloud#3680 is a pull request — .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md: its 状态模型 lists the six states as 「issue 上的信号」 and says 「`pm:awaiting-merge` 只挂 PR、不入六态」, and of `needs-user-decision` 「只挂决策卡(issue)、⛔ 永不挂 PR」 — so a PR waiting on the maintainer carries `pm:awaiting-merge` instead; removing a label is never refused.
⛔ NOTHING WAS WRITTEN.
```

**`pm:awaiting-merge` onto an issue**, `--add pm:awaiting-merge` on an issue carrying `pm:dispatched`:

- Before (`main` d3f36861): exit 0, 1 write — `④ MATCHES the target — labels \`pm:dispatched\`, \`pm:awaiting-merge\``.
- After: exit 2, 0 writes:

```text
② REFUSED — `pm:awaiting-merge` is the pull-request inbox label and objectstack-ai/objectstack#31148 is an issue — .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md: 「`pm:awaiting-merge` 只挂 PR、不入六态」 — so a card waiting on the maintainer's decision carries `needs-user-decision` instead; removing a label is never refused.
⛔ NOTHING WAS WRITTEN.
```

Still allowed, each a self-test case: `--remove needs-user-decision --add pm:awaiting-merge` on a PR (the cleanup), a removal-only write on either kind, `pm:awaiting-merge` onto a PR, any state onto an issue, and an unrelated add on a PR that already carries a state.

## Self-test

`node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, **165 cases pass across 13 batteries** (main: 144 across 12). The new battery "the kind rule" holds 21 cases (floor pinned at 21; battery floor 12 → 13), among them: a state onto a PR refused (and all six states), `needs-user-decision` onto a PR quoting its own line, `pm:awaiting-merge` onto an issue refused, a removal passes on both kinds, `pm:awaiting-merge` onto a PR passes, an unreadable kind refused (and an ungoverned add on it passes), the relay path dispatches nothing, `--release` on a PR sends nothing (also when the PR already carries `pm:queue`), and the unreadable-kind sentence agrees in number with the labels it names.

Mutation check: with both refusal sites disabled, 11 of the 165 cases fail; with the release site asking only of the labels it would newly POST, 1 fails (the already-carries-`pm:queue` case). Sibling self-tests that drive `runLabelWrite`: `close-cards.mjs --self-test` 227 pass, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --self-test` 331 pass.
